name: aegisdb
description: What this project is made of, as typed facts. A worked example of predicates.example.json — and the corpus that found the bug fixed in #269, where derived conclusions read as '#4 part_of #1' and no keyword query could reach them. Entities are named by `label`; facts refer to those labels and the loader turns them into record ids.
facts: The storage layer is part of the server.
The query layer is part of the server.
The newline-delimited JSON protocol is part of the server.
hnsw.c holds the HNSW graph and lives in the storage layer.
The append-only log is the storage layer's system of record.
Compaction rewrites the log in place, reclaiming tombstones.
usage_index.c tracks recall counts and last-recalled times.
lexical_index.c is the BM25 keyword index.
edge_index.c is the reverse relationship index.
fact_index.c answers pattern lookups over typed facts.
conflict_set.c retains the contradictions the inference pass finds.
The BM25 index is an in-RAM derived index.
The reverse edge index is an in-RAM derived index.
The fact indexes are in-RAM and derived.
The usage index is the one index the log cannot rebuild, so it checkpoints.
A checkpointed index is still an in-RAM derived index; it just also persists.
Retraction walks derived_from backwards, which needs the reverse edge index.
The inference pass reads the fact set through the fact indexes.
The LangGraph store adapter is built on the Python client.
The MCP integration speaks the wire protocol directly.
The exporter scrapes stats over the wire protocol.
Compaction rewrites the log, so it depends on it.
The BM25 index is disabled by --no-lexical-index; a query then answers NOT_READY.
The reverse edge index is disabled by --no-edge-index; a backward traverse answers NOT_READY.
The fact indexes are disabled by --no-fact-index; a pattern answers NOT_READY.
Usage feedback is disabled by --no-usage-feedback, and forget falls back to write-time importance.
Inference is off unless --inference is passed; it grows the log rather than RAM.
Vector recall and latency are measured by make bench.
The symbolic path is graded by make eval-multihop.
Hybrid retrieval is graded by the lexical eval mode.
Prose-to-triple extraction is graded by make eval-extraction.
The client's whole method surface is exercised by make sdk-test.
The store adapter is graded against LangGraph's own InMemoryStore.
The wire protocol's contract is pinned by make integration.
The server listens on 9470 unless --port says otherwise.
The Python client connects to 127.0.0.1:9470 by default.
Background summarization is off unless AEGIS_SUMMARY_MODE names a backend.
